principle.thesis: Internal actuator authority can disappear in flight without inventing an external root impulse. The root stays ballistic while joint stiffness collapses, changing collision eligibility. Ground support is earned later through passive knee-first contact, delayed foot support, torso overrun, and only then actuator restoration under load.
principle.novelty: Unlike prior Airborne017-033, the decisive airborne event is an internal constraint-authority loss rather than a tool impulse, rider/chassis counterpitch, hook catch, stall/flare, whiff, clearance tuck, pendular release, vault, compliant catcher, wall glance, payload acquisition, moving-platform undercatch, midair recoil vector bend, opposed-body glance, slope contact, aperture fold, or breakaway support/redrop. No external contact occurs at the authority loss.

keys.motion_arc_root_note: root compressed low before takeoff; both feet own root

keys.label: SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support release earns one continuous ballistic root arc
keys.causal_role: external support ends; powered body commits up-right

keys.label: ASCEND_STIFF
keys.motion_arc_root_note: ballistic rise; articulated pose remains actively organized
keys.causal_role: active stiffness shapes silhouette without new support

keys.label: APEX_LOCK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: apex read; root velocity transitions through zero vertical speed

keys.label: ACTUATOR_CUT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: internal authority changes but root remains on ballistic trajectory; no impulse injected
keys.causal_role: joint stiffness authority revoked at apex exit

keys.label: PASSIVE_FOLD_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: descent begins; distal joints lag downward while root keeps traveling right

keys.label: SLACK_DESCENT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: unsupported descent steepens; loose limbs trail behind root translation
keys.causal_role: passive collapse becomes visible as negative-space shrink

keys.label: PRECONTACT_SLACK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: separated floor precontact; left knee/shin is lowest eligible passive catcher
keys.causal_role: body cannot actively open; collision eligibility comes from slack geometry

keys.label: LEFT_KNEE_FIRST_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left knee acquires floor support while forward root momentum survives
keys.causal_role: passive first catch converts fall into slide/rotation

keys.label: PASSIVE_CRUSH_RIGHT_FOOT_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues right/down into asymmetric passive crush; second support is delayed
keys.causal_role: ground reaction pays vertical speed without active brace

keys.label: TORSO_OVERRUN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right foot becomes primary while torso/head overshoot past root
keys.causal_role: secondary lag exposes unresolved momentum debt

keys.label: ACTUATOR_RESTORE_UNDER_LOAD

keys.causal_role: active stiffness re-enters under load rather than resetting pose

keys.label: POWERED_RISE_RESTACK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: powered joints extend from loaded support; root rises locally without reversing flight
keys.causal_role: recovery spends ground support to rebuild stature

keys.label: DISPLACED_STABLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: stable at a new address; no idle-position rewind

compile.connective_motion: deterministic authored-key interpolation; support/contact/actuator states remain owned by authored keys

findings: active load and support break are visibly distinct before flight
power cut changes local joint authority without a discontinuity in the root arc
limbs progressively droop and silhouette compacts during unsupported descent
left-knee first contact is separated from precontact and precedes delayed right-foot support
passive crush and torso/head overrun visibly pay residual momentum
actuator restoration occurs only after two-foot support is reacquired
recovery rises from the displaced loaded state and does not rewind to the launch address

noodle_queen.judgment: The powered-to-slack silhouette collapse is specific and readable; the knee-first passive crash, delayed support, and under-load reboot make the phrase authored rather than a generic jump with a status label.
